source.author: lucan
source.text: Impia tot populis, tot surdas gentibus aures Coelicolum dirae convertunt carmina gentis.
source.text_original: Impia tot populis, tot surdas gentibus aures / Coelicolum dirae convertunt carmina gentis.
source.text_english: The impious songs of that accursed race turn the ears of the gods against so many peoples, against so many nations deaf to them.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hunc sibi praecipuum gentis de more nefandae Thessalis in seros Ditis servaverat usus:
reuse.text_original: hunc sibi praecipuum gentis de more nefandae / Thessalis in seros Ditis servaverat usus: /
reuse.text_english: The Thessalian custom of that accursed race had reserved him for itself as its special victim for the late rites of Dis.
